paragraphs.text: Kalan is a city on the Craggy Coast of southern Jamuraa , on the plane of Dominaria .
Not much is known of this city, but a king rules it, and its army, whose cavalry is best prized, wears brown uniforms. It is famous for its bathhouses and has friendly relations with Bryce .

After the Battle of Bryce , Hazezon Tamar sent out requests for aid from the other cities on the Craggy Coast, as their future fate would be the same: subjugation to the rising Emperor, Johan . Kalan responded to Hazezon's call to arms, sending cavalry and sappers to participate in the Battle of Palmyra .
